subject.title: feat: show Codex sessions and paginated transcripts in the sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor experimental-version-gated Codex transcript browsing as a first-class primary-sidebar workflow now?
rationale: Source proves the path is feasible but does not decide primary navigation, the permanent plugin/core seam, transcript authorization scope, or the minimum supported Codex App Server capability.

options.title: Sponsor version-gated browsing
options.body: Implement read-only bounded transcript pages now with explicit unsupported-host UX while leaving continuation and archive ownership unchanged.

options.title: Keep plugin-page navigation
options.body: Add transcript details within the existing Codex Sessions tab without placing Codex sessions in the primary sidebar.

options.title: Wait for stable protocol
options.body: Defer implementation until item pagination has a stable shipped Codex compatibility commitment.

recommendation.title: Sponsor version-gated browsing
recommendation.body: Implement read-only bounded transcript pages now with explicit unsupported-host UX while leaving continuation and archive ownership unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the latest focused catalog change and opened this immediate follow-up product direction.
